messages:
mike: Hey team — quick ping. I opened PR #4621 that narrows the k8s service account scope for the onprem auth sidecar and adds a small secret-handling helper. Can someone from sec/privacy skim? Link: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/4621 :wave:

tara: taking a look now. main concerns?

mike: mainly: 1) does the helper crate any extra secret files on disk? 2) VPC egress check for telemetry to our metrics endpoint (should be internal only) 3) merge timing — we want this in the canary deploy tomorrow morning if secure.

sofia: quick skim — helper writes a temp file under /tmp/redd-helper and cleans up, but we should avoid writing plaintext blobs. Can we switch it to in-memory and pass the token via stdin?

mike: good call. I can change to stdin. that will also avoid accidental core dumps.

jess: I can review the k8s SA rules. will check RBAC and confirm minimal scopes. ETA ~30m.

sec-review-bot: Security checklist automation run: secrets-scan=passed, iam-minimum-scan=warning (ServiceAccount uses two verbs that may be reducible), kms-access=none, telemetry-hosts=external-detected. See /checks/4621-report.

tara: @mike the telemetry host flagged by the bot is the metrics proxy (metrics.redwood.internal) but in onprem packaging that resolves to the customer's metrics collector and is allowed. Still, we should add an explicit allowlist or fallback to local no-op when DNS doesn't resolve. Can you add a config flag?

mike: yes — will add a `--telemetry-mode={remote|disabled}` flag and default disabled for onprem builds.

sofia: re: tmp file change, here's a suggested snippet for stdin usage:
```bash
# receiver side
read -r SECRET || exit 1
echo "$SECRET" | run-helper --from-stdin
```

mike: copying that into the PR in a minute. thanks.

jess: RBAC notes: reduce verb list to get/list/create only on the specific secret resource. I'll post exact YAML change in comments.

mike: perfect. once those updates are in, can sec approve? we have a deploy window tomorrow 09:00-10:00 UTC. need one sec + one eng approval.

tara: I can sign off after the telemetry flag and stdin change. leave a comment when done. :thumbsup:

sec-review-bot: Reminder: for onprem merges, CI must pass `onprem-smoke` and `license-scan`. Ensure both green before merge.

mike: pushed changes for stdin + telemetry flag, updated docs block. also added a short smoke plan in the PR description: run canary on a single node for 15m, confirm no outbound connections in tcpdump, then scale to 3 nodes.

sofia: re-ran local secret flow, no files left behind. LGTM from my side. :eyes:

jess: posted RBAC patch. looks minimal. tagging @prodops to coordinate canary window.

tara: leaving final sec approve once CI green.

mike: thanks everyone — marking this for canary tomorrow. will follow up in #eng-oncall with deploy notes.

(sec-review-bot reaction: :white_check_mark: PR-ready-if-ci-passes)
